content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice gives two qualification categories for the JRF post. Marks are counted as percentage or CGPA, as printed. A valid GATE or CSIR-NET score is preferable for both categories. Desirable experience: prior exposure to molecular simulation (molecular dynamics, Monte Carlo or DFT) or scientific programming (Python/C/C++, Linux) is an advantage but not essential. The notice says a keen interest in computational research and a willingness to learn matter most, and that the tools and methods will be taught. The maximum age limit is 28 years for the GEN/GEN-EWS category, 31 years for OBC-NCL, and 33 years for SC/ST/PwD/Female candidates. These limits are relaxable as per institute/funding-agency norms. The notice prints no date for counting age. Candidates should check the official notice for the full eligibility details.

rows.essential_qualification: B.E./B.Tech in Chemical, Materials, Metallurgical, Mechanical or Energy Engineering (or a related engineering discipline)

M.Tech/M.E in Chemical, Materials, Metallurgical, Mechanical or Energy Engineering (or a related engineering discipline); or M.Sc. in Physics or Chemistry (or a closely related science relevant to molecular simulation / energy storage)

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The emoluments are ₹37,000 per month + HRA as per norms (as per sanctioned project norms). The duration is 2 years or till closure of the project, whichever is earlier, and performance evaluation will be done each year. The notice describes the position as purely temporary. The selected candidate may register for a PhD as per institute rules, by applying when PhD admissions are open.

content_sections.heading: NIT Warangal Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Job Description
content_sections.text: Carry out atomistic/molecular simulation (molecular dynamics, Monte Carlo and DFT) of hard-carbon anodes, covering pore structure, SEI formation and sodium storage for sodium-ion batteries. Carry out the associated data analysis and visualisation.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIT Warangal Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Complete the application form given on page 2 of the notice (Advt. No. NITW/2026/CH/PKB/ARCI). Attach the latest CV/Resume; the notice asks for a brief resume/curriculum vitae/biodata along with the form. Email both to [email protected] . Write the subject line as: Application for JRF position. Send the application by 5 December 2026. The form asks for name, father's name, date of birth, sex, marital status, category, educational qualifications, GATE/NET/ICMR/DBT-SRF score, research/industrial/teaching experience, publications, other relevant information and contact email and phone number. It ends with a declaration, which includes confirming availability for an ONLINE interview if necessary, and the candidate's signature. For queries, the contact is Dr. Praveen Kumar Bommineni (Principal Investigator), Department of Chemical Engineering, National Institute of Technology Warangal, Telangana, India, phone 9652941841, email [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The list of eligible candidates will be announced on the institute website or intimated through email. Shortlisted candidates will have to attend an interview, which may be ONLINE or OFFLINE. If the interview is online, candidates are expected to have a good internet connection. The notice gives no interview date.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The position is purely temporary. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Candidates whose information is found false or incorrect, or who are found ineligible before or after selection, are liable to have their candidature cancelled, as stated in the declaration.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the NIT Warangal JRF post?
faq.answer: Category A needs a B.E./B.Tech in Chemical, Materials, Metallurgical, Mechanical or Energy Engineering (or a related engineering discipline). Category B needs an M.Tech/M.E in the same disciplines, or an M.Sc. in Physics or Chemistry (or a closely related science). Minimum marks differ by category of candidate.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the JRF?
faq.answer: The emoluments are ₹37,000 per month + HRA as per norms (as per sanctioned project norms).

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Complete the application form on page 2 of the notice and email it with your latest CV/Resume to [email protected], using the subject line "Application for JRF position".

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: The list of eligible candidates will be announced on the institute website or intimated through email, and shortlisted candidates will attend an interview, online or offline.

faq.answer: No, the notice calls the position purely temporary. The duration is 2 years or till closure of the project, whichever is earlier, with performance evaluation each year.

faq.answer: Yes, the emoluments are printed as ₹37,000 per month + HRA as per norms, as per sanctioned project norms.
